dimensions.name: Process Digitization
dimensions.journey: From manual workflows to autonomous processes

levels.1: Run on Excel, email and phone; data re-keyed between steps
levels.2: Point systems/portals digitise steps, but hand-offs and re-entry remain
levels.3: Systems integrated end-to-end; one workflow, one record through the process
levels.4: Rule-based automation and exception management; predictive triggers
levels.5: Self-optimising process; AI agents act within guardrails, humans supervise

levels.1: Spreadsheet reporting, manual consolidation, multiple versions of truth
levels.2: System reports and dashboards, periodic and descriptive
levels.3: Governed single source of truth; master data managed; self-serve dashboards
levels.4: Predictive models used in decisions (forecasts, risk scores)
levels.5: Prescriptive, real-time decisioning embedded in workflows

levels.1: Awareness only; no AI in use
levels.3: At least one AI use case in production for the function
levels.4: Multiple scaled use cases with monitoring and governance
levels.5: AI embedded in core decisions and agentic workflows; continuous learning

dimensions.name: People Skills
dimensions.journey: From digitally dependent to digital innovators

levels.1: Dependent on IT/vendors for basic system tasks and reports
levels.3: Power users; self-serve analytics; trained on new tools
levels.4: Digital champions network; citizen development; data literacy programmes
levels.5: Teams co-create digital/AI solutions; continuous upskilling culture
